analysis.session_summary: Full Asia-London-NY session saw SNB dominate: CHF sold 0.513% despite unchanged rate, then recovered only 0.070% at the press conference. AUD employment beat 39.5K vs 21.5K but inverted to -0.119%, signaling selling into strength. President Trump Speaks added 0.053% USD strength; USD Unemployment Claims and CAD retail sales were muted. NZD was strongest major (+0.16%), JPY weakest (-0.181%), leaving EUR/USD essentially flat (+0.5 pips).

themes.theme: SNB policy assessment drove CHF weakness and cross volatility
themes.evidence: CHF weakened 0.513% on SNB Monetary Policy Assessment; EUR/CHF closed +23.2 pips, USD/CHF +19.9 pips; press conference reversed only 0.070%.
Employment Change printed 39.5K vs 21.5K forecast, yet AUD weakened 0.119%; AUD/USD closed -3.4 pips.

themes.theme: NZD strongest, JPY weakest on flow
themes.evidence: NZD strength +0.16%, JPY -0.181% mean vs majors; NZD/JPY moved +0.341%.

currency_drivers.USD: Trump speech added 0.053% USD strength; unemployment claims muted inside noise floor.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own releases; sold early, recovered 86%, second strongest at +0.095% on SNB CHF weakness.
currency_drivers.JPY: No catalyst; weakest major at -0.181%, attempt rejected after leading +0.27%.
currency_drivers.GBP: No own catalyst; closed at its best but only +0.058%, modest against weak CHF/JPY.
currency_drivers.AUD: Employment beat was inverted: +39.5K vs +21.5K forecast, yet AUD weakened 0.119%; later selling rejected.
currency_drivers.CAD: Retail sales miss was muted; CAD attempt rejected, gave back 100% to -0.113%.
currency_drivers.CHF: SNB rate unchanged but assessment sold CHF 0.513%; press conference recovered 0.070%, attempt rejected overall.
currency_drivers.NZD: No domestic catalyst; top major at +0.16%, riding CHF weakness in SNB-driven NZD/CHF flows.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD traced a 39.8-pip range of alternating up/down legs with no clear catalyst except President Trump Speaks adding a -5.2 pips 15-min USD push late; close +0.5 pips.

polarity_reads.read: AUD job beat 39.5K vs 21.5K forecast but AUD weakened 0.119%; inverted reaction says the market used strong data to sell AUD, stretched longs.
CHF sold 0.513% with no forecast to score; large move implies positioning was not ready for an unchanged/hawkish-lite SNB.
197K vs 201K forecast, basket moved only 0.004%; muted, no USD impulse.
-0.7% vs -0.5% forecast, basket -0.022%; muted, no CAD impulse.

scenarios.name: CHF weakness extends
scenarios.thesis: SNB assessment sold CHF 0.513% and press conference recovery was only 0.070%; path of least resistance is further CHF downside.
triggers: SNB press conference does not extend CHF recovery beyond 0.070%
scenarios.invalidation: CHF recovers more than 0.070% and EUR/CHF breaks below 0.94177

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/CHF closed +23.2 pips at 0.94177 near top of 60.1-pip range; SNB assessment sold CHF 0.513%, press conference recovered only 0.070%.

scenarios.name: AUD rebound
scenarios.thesis: AUD selling was rejected after the inverted jobs beat, recovering 76% from -0.15% low; unwinding of stretched shorts can lift AUD.
triggers: AUD employment inverted move reverses as selling rejected
scenarios.invalidation: AUD/USD breaks below 0.70252 and extends lower

pair_paths.rationale: AUD/USD closed -3.4 pips but AUD selling was rejected, recovering 76% from -0.15% low; inverted jobs beat may unwind.

scenarios.name: USD range
scenarios.thesis: USD lacks fresh catalyst after muted unemployment claims and a Trump speech that only added 0.053%; EUR/USD stays inside its 39.8-pip range.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD closed +0.5 pips inside 39.8-pip range with close in range 0.48; USD lacks fresh catalyst after muted claims and Trump speech.

risks.why_it_matters: SNB assessment sold CHF 0.513%, press conference recovered only 0.070%; further CHF swings can reset EUR/CHF and USD/CHF ranges.
Jobs beat sold AUD 0.119%; if AUD longs unwind further, AUD crosses can underperform despite strong data.
Late US-Iran phased deal report caused sharp reversal in USD/MXN and Brent; risk-off could rally CHF/JPY.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: Ahead: BOE Gov Bailey Speaks (High) can move GBP; Revised UoM Consumer Sentiment forecast 47.4 vs previous 47.8 and inflation expectations previous 4.6% can shift USD.
